#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>
#include <sstream>

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    std::string input, line;
    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        input += line + '\n';
    }

    std::istringstream iss(input);
    std::string token;
    if (iss >> token) {
        std::string extended = "#" + token;
        std::regex pattern("(.)\\1*");
        std::smatch match;
        std::string::const_iterator searchStart(extended.cbegin());
        int ans = 0;
        while (std::regex_search(searchStart, extended.cend(), match, pattern)) {
            int length = match.length();
            if ((length & 1) == 0) {
                ans++;
            }
            searchStart = match.suffix().first;
        }
        std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << 0 << std::endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
